patch.value: GH-943: health remediation points at validate while actionable unknown-author recovery remains undiscoverable

GitHub issue https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/943 reports that pm health emits a remediation_map route to pm validate --fix-hints for unknown-author events, but validate emits no actionable hint and the working history-author-acknowledge --all-actionable recovery is never named. Preserve one machine-executable remediation path across health, validate, contracts, CLI, and SDK.

Unknown-author health diagnostics name an executable remediation that resolves the reported actionable set; validate --fix-hints either emits the same recovery or is no longer advertised for this warning; CLI, SDK, MCP, help, and contracts agree on the recovery path; regression tests cover actionable, legacy-only, empty, and partial-disposition cases; token-bounded output retains the remediation without private event data
